008package paint.getomero.app;
009
010import javax.swing.*;
011import java.awt.*;
012import java.io.File;
013import java.io.IOException;
014
015/**
016 * A graphical user interface for processing Omero-exported "Fileset" directories.
017 * <p>
018 * This Swing-based tool enables users to:
019 * <ul>
020 *   <li>Select a root directory containing "Fileset" subdirectories.</li>
021 *   <li>Automatically move valid files to the root directory.</li>
022 *   <li>Delete empty "Fileset" folders after processing.</li>
023 *   <li>Display a scrollable list of remaining files.</li>
024 * </ul>
025 * The interface provides buttons for browsing, processing, and closing, with clear
026 * error handling for invalid directories or I/O failures.
027 */
028public class GetOmeroUI extends JFrame {
029
030    private final JTextField directoryField;
031
032    /**
033     * Constructs a new instance of the {@code GetOmeroUI} class and initializes
034     * the application window with controls for directory selection, processing,
035     * and viewing results.
036     */
037    public GetOmeroUI() {
038        super("Get Omero");
039        setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
040
041        // Base font (plain, small)
042        Font baseFont = new JLabel().getFont().deriveFont(Font.PLAIN, 12f);
043
044        JPanel content = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(8, 8));
045        content.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(12, 12, 12, 12));
046
047        // --- Directory selection panel ---
048        JPanel dirPanel = new JPanel(new GridBagLayout());
049        GridBagConstraints gbc = new GridBagConstraints();
050        gbc.insets = new Insets(2, 2, 2, 2);
051        gbc.gridy = 0;
052
053        JLabel dirLabel = new JLabel("Directory:");
054        dirLabel.setFont(baseFont);
055
056        directoryField = new JTextField(System.getProperty("user.home"));
057        directoryField.setEditable(false);
058        directoryField.setFont(baseFont);
059        directoryField.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(320, 24));
060
061        JButton browseButton = new JButton("Browse…");
062        browseButton.setFont(baseFont);
063        browseButton.setMargin(new Insets(2, 8, 2, 8));
064        browseButton.addActionListener(e -> onBrowse());
065
066        gbc.gridx  = 0;
067        gbc.anchor = GridBagConstraints.WEST;
068        dirPanel.add(dirLabel, gbc);
069
070        gbc.gridx   = 1;
071        gbc.fill    = GridBagConstraints.HORIZONTAL;
072        gbc.weightx = 1.0;
073        dirPanel.add(directoryField, gbc);
074
075        gbc.gridx   = 2;
076        gbc.fill    = GridBagConstraints.NONE;
077        gbc.weightx = 0.0;
078        dirPanel.add(browseButton, gbc);
079
080        // --- Action buttons ---
081        JPanel buttonPanel = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 8, 4));
082        JButton processButton = new JButton("Process");
083        JButton closeButton = new JButton("Close");
084        processButton.setFont(baseFont);
085        closeButton.setFont(baseFont);
086        buttonPanel.add(processButton);
087        buttonPanel.add(closeButton);
088
089        processButton.addActionListener(e -> onProcess());
090        closeButton.addActionListener(e -> dispose());
091
092        // Layout
093        content.add(dirPanel, BorderLayout.CENTER);
094        content.add(buttonPanel, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
095
096        add(content, BorderLayout.CENTER);
097        pack();
098
099        // Fix width = 500, keep auto height
100        Dimension size = getSize();
101        setSize(new Dimension(500, size.height));
102        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
103        setVisible(true);
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * Handles the action event triggered when the user clicks the "Browse" button.
108     * Opens a directory chooser dialog and updates the directory path display.
109     */
110    private void onBrowse() {
111        JFileChooser chooser = new JFileChooser(directoryField.getText());
112        chooser.setFileSelectionMode(JFileChooser.DIRECTORIES_ONLY);
113        if (chooser.showOpenDialog(this) == JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) {
114            File selected = chooser.getSelectedFile();
115            directoryField.setText(selected.getAbsolutePath());
116        }
117    }
118
119    /**
120     * Executes when the "Process" button is clicked. Processes all "Fileset" subdirectories
121     * of the selected folder by invoking {@code ProcessOmeroFiles.process()}, then displays
122     * a summary of remaining files in a scrollable dialog.
123     */
124    private void onProcess() {
125        String path = directoryField.getText();
126        if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) {
127            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this, "Please select a directory first.",
128                                          "Error", JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
129            return;
130        }
131        File rootDir = new File(path);
132        if (!rootDir.isDirectory()) {
133            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this, "Invalid directory.",
134                                          "Error", JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
135            return;
136        }
137
138        try {
139            ProcessOmeroFiles.process(rootDir);
140
141            // Collect visible files now in the directory (skip dotfiles)
142            File[] remaining = rootDir.listFiles(f -> f.isFile() && !f.getName().startsWith("."));
143            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
144            if (remaining != null && remaining.length > 0) {
145                for (File f : remaining) {
146                    sb.append(f.getName()).append("\n");
147                }
148            } else {
149                sb.append("(No files found)");
150            }
151
152            // Display them in a scrollable dialog
153            JTextArea area = new JTextArea(sb.toString(), 15, 50);
154            area.setEditable(false);
155            area.setFont(new JLabel().getFont().deriveFont(Font.PLAIN, 12f));
156            JScrollPane scroll = new JScrollPane(area);
157
158            String dialogTitle = "Processing completed — " + rootDir.getAbsolutePath();JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(
159                    this,
160                    scroll,
161                    dialogTitle,
162                    JOptionPane.INFORMATION_MESSAGE
163            );
164
165        } catch (IOException ex) {
166            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this,
167                                          "Error during processing:\n" + ex.getMessage(),
168                                          "Error",
169                                          JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
170        }
171    }
172
173    /**
174     * Launches the Get Omero GUI.
175     */
176    public static void main(String[] args) {
177        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(GetOmeroUI::new);
178    }
179}
